item.tib: ma cig skal bzang gis zhus len
item.coloph: ma cig yum chen dngos grub 'di/ dad ldan sprang po'i (pos) zhus pa yin/ dkar chags (chag)dag la btab pa la/ bder gshegs dgongs rgyud rig 'dzin lha tshogs dang / ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams thams cad la/ mi 'thad thugs 'gal yod na bzod gsol mthol lo bshags/ 'di la spros pa'i dge rtsa ci bgyis pa/ ma rig sems can rmongs pa'i don du bsngo/ u ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ gshen sras lha rje'i drung du/ shes rab dpal bdag gis zhus so//
